newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua says damaged conveyor belt fixed.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua says damaged conveyor belt fixed.

text.p: Brazil's Paranagua port said a conveyor belt damaged in a fire last week had been repaired and was back in use since early Sunday.
"It started working again yesterday morning," a port spokeswoman said.
The repair of the belt, which runs from a soybean silo into the port, was completed ahead of schedule after being damaged by a fire on March 24. It has a capacity for loading 1,500 tonnes per hour.
All five conveyor belts at the port terminal were operating normally, the spokeswoman said.
